premise: Bear cub wants to stay up all winter but keeps yawning; Badger digs him a den, he sleeps through the snow, and Bird wakes him with the first spring song.
inspiration: Rip Van Winkle, turned: sleeping through is safe and cosy, and friends are waiting when you wake.
lesson: Resting is nothing to miss out on; friends will be there when you wake.
learning: Bears sleep through much of the winter in a den

en-US.title: Bear Cub Waits for Spring
en-US.text: The days were getting shorter and colder. Along toddled the {bear:enter} bear cub. [excited] {bear:face happy} I'm staying up ALL winter to see the snow! {badger:enter} Badger came trotting by. {badger:face surprised} [curious] All winter? Bears sleep in winter, in a den. {badger:live} He sniffed the ground, dug with his front paws, pushed his nose into the hole… and popped up grinning, with earth on his nose. {bear:shake 0.4} [giggles] The bear cub tried hard to stay awake. {bear:live hold} But he yawned, stretched up high, rubbed his eyes… and nodded off. {badger:face happy} [softly] Badger {badger:hearts} tucked dry leaves around him. {canvas:snow 0.6 10s} All winter long the snow fell, and the bear cub slept, snug and warm. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 16s} Then one morning, {bird:enter} Bird flew down onto a branch. {bird:live} He puffed up his chest and {sfx:spring-song} sang his brightest song. {bear:live resume} The bear cub woke with a start, blinked… and smiled. {bear:face happy} Is it snowing yet? {bird:face happy} [laughs] No, sleepyhead, said Bird. {bear:hop x2} It's spring!

es-ES.title: El osito espera la primavera
es-ES.text: Los días eran cada vez más cortos y más fríos. Llegó el {bear:enter} osito a pasitos. [excited] {bear:face happy} ¡Me quedaré despierto TODO el invierno para ver la nieve! {badger:enter} Tejón pasó trotando. {badger:face surprised} [curious] ¿Todo el invierno? Los osos duermen en invierno, en una guarida. {badger:live} Olfateó el suelo, escarbó con las patas, metió el hocico en el agujero… y asomó sonriendo, con tierra en la nariz. {bear:shake 0.4} [giggles] El osito intentó no dormirse. {bear:live hold} Pero bostezó, se estiró, se frotó los ojos… y se quedó dormido. {badger:face happy} [softly] Tejón {badger:hearts} lo arropó con hojas secas. {canvas:snow 0.6 10s} Todo el invierno cayó la nieve, y el osito durmió, calentito y a gusto. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 16s} Hasta que una mañana, {bird:enter} Pájaro bajó volando a una rama. {bird:live} Infló el pecho y {sfx:spring-song} cantó su canción más alegre. {bear:live resume} El osito se despertó de un respingo, parpadeó… y sonrió. {bear:face happy} ¿Ya está nevando? {bird:face happy} [laughs] No, dormilón, dijo Pájaro. {bear:hop x2} ¡Es primavera!

spring-song.prompt: a bright little songbird singing a happy spring morning song
